page_title: RBL 3-1 FRE | RB Leipzig v Freiburg 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+2' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball goes behind for a corner. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+2' Andre Silva (RB Leipzig) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Noah Atubolu and he's equal to it.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
89' Florent Muslija (Freiburg) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!
88' Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig) has tested the patience of referee Sven Jablonski and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
87' Julian Schuster decides to make a substitution. Christian Gunter will be replaced by Matthias Ginter (Freiburg).
87' Substitution. Eren Dinkci walks off the pitch and Lucas Holer (Freiburg) comes on as a substitute.
86' One of the players from Freiburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
85' A pass from Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) is intercepted by Maarten Vandevoordt and the move breaks down.
85' Florent Muslija (Freiburg) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
84' The Freiburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
80' Marco Rose prepares a substitution. Castello Lukeba is replaced by El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig).
80' Lutsharel Geertruida will be replaced by Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig).
80' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
78' 3 - 1 Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) runs on to a clever pass from Andre Silva and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He still has work to do but finishes with aplomb into the back of the net.
77' Florent Muslija (Freiburg) sends the corner into the box, but Maarten Vandevoordt intercepts it and averts the threat.
74' The attendance for today's match is 45000.

73' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
72' A snap shot by Florent Muslija (Freiburg) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Maarten Vandevoordt produces a good save to thwart him.
71' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
69' Sven Jablonski blows for a foul after Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
68' Substitution. Lukas Kubler will be replaced by Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg).
68' Here is a change. Vincenzo Grifo is going off and Julian Schuster gives the last tactical orders to Florent Muslija (Freiburg).
68' Junior Adamu comes off the pitch to be replaced by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg).
67' Sven Jablonski couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) and blew his whistle.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benjamin Sesko leaves the pitch and Andre Silva (RB Leipzig) comes on.
65' Marco Rose has decided to substitute Amadou Haidara and he is replaced by Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig).
64' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
61' 8:11 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
58' 2 - 1 Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) latches on to a killer pass deep inside the box and coolly puts the ball inside the right post!
56' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
53' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header directed into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort.
52' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
51' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) trips an opposition player and Sven Jablonski signals a foul. Freiburg have a free kick from a promising distance.
49' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
47' 1 - 1 Goal! Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Benjamin Henrichs, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
47' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sven Jablonski had an easy-decision to make.
46' Marco Rose is forced to make a change. Peter Gulacsi (RB Leipzig) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Maarten Vandevoordt.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post.

43' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Noah Atubolu dived superbly to block the header from around the penalty spot, which was aimed straight towards the bottom left corner by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
38' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) misses a great chance after producing a powerful header towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a world-class save.
38' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Junior Adamu (Freiburg) was quite harsh and Sven Jablonski didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) for his blatant foul.
36' A corner kick by RB Leipzig is thwarted by the well prepared Noah Atubolu (Freiburg).

36' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Noah Atubolu. Good work from RB Leipzig as they win a corner.
34' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the right post.
33' Freiburg hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
31' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
30' RB Leipzig are seeing far more of the ball now.
28' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
27' Freiburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
25' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) sends a long ball in, but Noah Atubolu comfortably gathers the ball.
24' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
23' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
22' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.

21' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi keeps it out.
20' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Freiburg have a free kick.
19' Dangerous play by Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig). Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
18' The ball possession is 46:54.
15' 0 - 1 Vincenzo Grifo launches a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) rises high to head the ball into the right side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. 0:1.
14' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.

12' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball after the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the bottom left corner, but Noah Atubolu makes a nice save.
12' Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Sven Jablonski interrupted the game to signal a free kick. RB Leipzig have a free kick.
11' Golden chance! Junior Adamu (Freiburg) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
10' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
10' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) makes a rough challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
9' CHANCE! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
7' Great teamplay by Freiburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
4' Freiburg take a short corner kick.
4' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
3' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
RB Leipzig will kick-off.
Sven Jablonski will supervise the game today.
